description: Model fallback chains for Zouroboros agent self-healing. v7 (2026-05-17): Multi-vendor staggered failback. Haiku (Anthropic/OpenRouter) → Sonnet (Anthropic) → GPT-5 (OpenAI/OpenRouter) → Kimi (synthetic.new). Sonnet → Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google/OpenRouter) → Kimi. Opus → Gemini → Kimi. GPT-5 → Kimi. Gemini → Kimi. Kimi is terminal — no cascade beyond open-weight.

_policy.note: Validator accepts a terminal rung that is open-weight OR zo-native. Chains whose primary is itself open-weight or zo-native may have empty fallbacks — in that case, exhaustion triggers an alert email rather than a cascade.

healerConfig.label: Zo Fast (built-in, no external dependency)
healerConfig.rule: The healer agent MUST run on a Zo-native model (zo:fast or zo:smart) that has no external provider dependency. Never add zo:fast or zo:smart to a fallback chain. This prevents the watchmen-failure cascade.

probeConfig.prompt: You are a health check responder. List the numbers 1 through 10, each on its own line. After the list, write exactly: HEALTH_CHECK_PASS

_removed_v5.note: Removed 2026-05-11 per user directive — these are no longer valid fallback destinations or chain heads. If an agent is still wired to one of these directly, the healer will not find a chain and will alert.

_removed_v6.note: v6 chains superseded 2026-05-17 by multi-vendor staggered failback. v6 only had Anthropic → Kimi linear chains. v7 adds cross-vendor failover via OpenRouter (GPT-5, Gemini 3.1 Pro) as intermediate rungs before terminal Kimi.
